'''''Lepidophorum''''' is a [[monotypic taxon|monotypic]] [[genus]] of flowering plants in the [[Asteraceae|daisy family]]. Its only known species is '''''Lepidophorum repandum''''', native to [[Spain]] and [[Portugal]].<ref name=j/><ref name=t/>
